description: Real GDP growth, quarter by quarter (seasonally and calendar adjusted), for one European country or the EU / euro area: change on the previous quarter by default, or on the same quarter a year earlier. Answers "is the German economy growing" or "is Italy in recession". Source: Eurostat dataset namq_10_gdp (chain-linked volumes). Recent quarters are revised as countries update their accounts. (cost: 1 credit)

comparison.description: string, optional: 'quarter' (change on previous quarter, default) or 'year' (change on same quarter a year earlier)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent quarters, 1-100, default 8

name: eu_gdp_growth
